tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Answer a question about the Xaurr API from the official docs (checkouts, fees, Connect, Payouts, webhooks, countries).

tools.name: get_api_reference
tools.description: The full reference for one part of the API. Sections: authentication, checkout-sessions, get-checkout, payments, quote, connect, payouts, links-invoices, webhooks, embed, countries.

tools.name: integration_example
tools.description: Tested starting code to create a Xaurr checkout from a server, or to verify a webhook. Stacks: node, nextjs, laravel, php, django, flutter, wordpress, webhook.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Explain an error message returned by the Xaurr API and how to fix it.

tools.name: test_values
tools.description: The phone numbers and values that complete or fail test payments and payouts, per country and payout speed.

tools.name: go_live_checklist
tools.description: What is needed before live keys take real payments.

tools.name: get_openapi
tools.description: Where to download the machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Xaurr API, for code generators and API tools.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Recent changes to the Xaurr API, newest first.

tools.name: create_test_checkout
tools.description: Create a TEST hosted checkout (POST /checkout-sessions) and return its pay url. Needs a test key with write permission.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Status of one checkout by your own order reference (GET /checkout-sessions/:reference).

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: The most recent test payments on the account (GET /payments).

tools.name: get_payment
tools.description: One payment by its receipt number (GET /payments/:receipt).

tools.name: quote_fees
tools.description: What a payment costs in Ghana cedis (GET /quote): what the customer pays, the fees, and what you receive.

tools.name: check_platform_connection
tools.description: Xaurr Connect: with the OPERATOR's test key, check they are connected to your platform (GET /platform-connection).

tools.name: payout_collection_methods
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: the ways a customer can pay in one currency's country (GET /collections/methods).

tools.name: payouts_balance
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: your test balance (GET /balance), optionally for one currency.

tools.name: account_readiness
tools.description: This account's own go-live checklist: what is done and what is still missing before live keys take real payments (GET /account/readiness).

tools.name: pay_test_checkout
tools.description: Pay (or fail) a TEST checkout with the right sandbox test number for its country and payout speed, like a customer would, so you see real statuses and webhooks without a phone. Ghana, Kenya and Uganda.

tools.name: refund_checkout
tools.description: Ask for a refund of a paid TEST checkout (POST /checkout-sessions/:reference/refund).

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Your test webhooks and their last 10 deliveries (GET /webhooks). No secrets are shown.

tools.name: send_test_webhook
tools.description: Send a signed test.ping to one of your test webhooks (POST /webhooks/:id/test). Verify the X-Xaurr-Signature on your side (integration_example webhook).

tools.name: payouts_test_topup
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: add TEST money to your balance (POST /balance/test-topup).

tools.name: payouts_add_worker
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: add a test worker (POST /workers). Returns their onboarding_url.

tools.name: payouts_get_worker
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: one worker's status, by their id or by your own reference (GET /workers/:id or /workers?reference=).

tools.name: payouts_credit_worker
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: credit a worker's earnings from your balance (POST /workers/:id/earnings).

tools.name: payouts_pay_worker
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: pay a worker out of their earnings (POST /workers/:id/withdrawals). Test money only.

tools.name: payouts_worker_history
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: one worker's earnings and payouts (GET /workers/:id/history).

tools.name: payouts_get_withdrawal
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: one payout's status (GET /withdrawals/:id): queued, paid, returned or needs_review.

tools.name: payouts_collect
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: ask a customer to pay into your balance by Mobile Money (POST /collections). Use test_values numbers.

tools.name: payouts_get_collection
tools.description: Xaurr Payouts: one collection's status (GET /collections/:id).

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a reusable payment link (POST /payment-links), paid into your own account in the currency's country. Test key = test link; live key = a real link to share. Ask the user to confirm before creating a live link.

tools.name: list_payment_links
tools.description: Your payment links for the key's environment, with how many times each was paid (GET /payment-links).

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice document (POST /invoices), the same as Create Invoice in the app. Needs a LIVE key: invoices are real documents. Ask the user to confirm first.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Your invoices, newest first, optionally only unpaid or paid (GET /invoices). Shows which are overdue. Needs a LIVE key: invoices are real documents.

tools.name: mark_invoice_paid
tools.description: Mark one of your invoices paid (POST /invoices/:id/mark-paid); it is also recorded in bookkeeping. Needs a LIVE key. Ask the user to confirm first.

tools.name: sales_summary
tools.description: Money received and sent in the last N days, per currency, completed only (GET /summary). Test key = test money; live key = real money.

tools.name: waiting_payouts
tools.description: Sales waiting for your payout schedule, the payout fee and what you will receive (GET /payouts/waiting). Needs a LIVE key: this is real money.

tools.name: platform_operators
tools.description: Platforms (Xaurr Connect): every operator connected to your platform, with country, agreed maximum fee and whether they can take live payments (GET /platform/operators). Use your own platform LIVE key.

tools.name: platform_earnings
tools.description: Platforms (Xaurr Connect): your fee earnings per currency and the latest ones, for the key's environment (GET /platform/earnings). Use your own platform key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_webhooks" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Your test webhooks and their last 10 deliveries (GET /webhooks). No secrets are shown.
